newsitem.title: GERMANY: South African jet blows tyres in Frankfurt landing.
newsitem.headline: South African jet blows tyres in Frankfurt landing.

text.p: A South African Airways Boeing 747 blew out 16 tyres during a scheduled landing at Frankfurt airport on Sunday night, blocking a main runway for more than seven hours, an airport official said on Monday.

None of the 146 passengers and 22 crew members aboard flight 253 from Amsterdam to Johannesburg, which included an interim stop in Frankfurt, was injured, Frankfurt airport spokeswoman Siegrun Weiss said.
"The brakes apparently locked up while the plane was landing and 16 of the tyres blew apart," she said.

Passengers were taken off the aircraft on the runway and workers then changed the plane's tyres before moving it to a hanger for inspection. The passengers were to be put aboard a South African Airways flight on Monday to Johannesburg.
Weiss said flights at Frankfurt airport, considered the busiest in continental Europe, were generally not affected since another runway was put into operation.
